review_events.rejection_comment: entity.status <- BN_STATUS is the status of the business-name registration, not the holder entity. A cancelled name does not mean a deregistered holder (e.g. a no-ABN row like 'Curry Festival' would emit entity.status=deregistered and could kill a live company downstream). Unmap entity.status with that reason. Also correct the unmap reason for BN_REG_DT/BN_CANCEL_DT: they are valid_from/valid_to material for the name claim, which this engine does not yet carry - say that, not 'no ontology field'.
